brand.name: Kabar Buruk
brand.tagline: Dokumentasi & Journalistik Kritis Skandal Politik Indonesia
brand.logo_concept: Monochrome sharp SVG mark featuring an inverted 'K' stamped inside a red-bordered headline badge with an eye or alert symbol. Usable as vector and favicon.

theme.description: Editorial Broadsheet & Critical Journalism style with warm paper background (#FAF8F5), high-contrast ink charcoal text (#0F172A), stark crimson accent (#DC2626) for scandals & alerts, and crisp gridlines (#E2E8F0).

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight font-serif text-slate-900 leading-[1.1]
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold font-serif text-slate-900 leading-snug
hierarchy.caption: text-xs tracking-wider uppercase font-mono text-slate-500 font-semibold

layout_and_grids.spacing_philosophy: Generous newsprint margins (p-6, p-8, p-12) with 1px sharp structural borders separating columns (Swiss Grid style)
layout_and_grids.hero_layout: Asymmetric 12-column Swiss grid: 8 cols for Lead Investigative Story with kinetic reveal, 4 cols for Live Scandal Wire & Critical Stats
layout_and_grids.rankings_grid: MODE B High-Density 4-column Swiss Data Matrix (Indonesia vs World Benchmarks)
layout_and_grids.article_feed_grid: Grid of 3 columns with distinct row spans for featured investigation, category badges, and loss counter
layout_and_grids.scandal_tracker_layout: Matrix filterable timeline with status filters (Pengalihan Isu, Menggantung, Dalam Proses Hukum, Dihentikan/SP3)

key_components.name: Header & Navigation
key_components.features: Top date/edition ribbon + slow editorial marquee, logo mark 'Kabar Buruk', search drawer trigger, category navigation, Admin portal access button, sticky glass background with blur.

key_components.name: Kinetic Hero Section
key_components.features: Masked-line reveal heading, live scandal stats ticker, full-bleed news photography with parallax, quick link to high-profile political cases.

key_components.name: Editorial Marquee
key_components.features: Slow drift ribbon highlighting key political keywords: RUU Pilkada 2024, Kerugian Negara Rp 300T, Kebebasan Pers #111, Tapera, Dinasti Politik, Megaproyek IKN.

key_components.name: Article Feed & Filters
key_components.features: Tabs for [Semua, Korupsi, Skandal, Kontroversi, Kebijakan, Pemilu], search bar, severity badges (Bahasa Indonesia), reading time, loss estimates.

key_components.name: World Rankings Statistics Matrix
key_components.features: Indonesia vs World Benchmarks: Corruption Perception Index (CPI), Press Freedom Index (Kebebasan Pers), Average IQ (IQ Rata-Rata), Education Index, Health Index, GDP ranking. Includes bar & rank visualization.

key_components.name: Scandal Tracker Archive
key_components.features: Interactive database of political scandals: Kerugian Negara counter, key actors involved, current legal status, timeline events, filtering by status & actor.

key_components.name: Article Detail Modal / Reader Comments
key_components.features: Full investigative reading view, sentiment reaction buttons (Marah, Kecewa, Waspada), reader comment submission with upvotes and replies.

key_components.name: Admin Dashboard Panel
key_components.features: Secured admin login with PIN/Password, article editor with live preview, scandal case management, ranking statistics updater, reader comment moderation.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete React application for 'Kabar Buruk' in JS files (React .jsx / .js, NOT .tsx).
Ensure all interactive buttons, inputs, links, tabs, forms, comment items, and admin fields contain data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='article-card-1', data-testid='admin-login-button').
Use Lenis for smooth scrolling and framer-motion for kinetic text reveal and entrance animations.
Implement full mock data in Bahasa Indonesia covering actual political discussions (Kasus Timah 300T, RUU Pilkada, Harun Masiku, Indeks Kebebasan Pers, IQ Rata-rata Indonesia, CPI Indeks Korupsi).

Implement functional state management: reader search filter, category switching, scandal status filtering, submitting comments, upvoting, admin authentication (PIN: 1234 or admin/admin), and admin CRUD operations.
Follow Swiss broadsheet styling: crisp 1px borders (border-slate-300), serif headings with Playfair Display, high contrast red accents, and dense structured data cards.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs; avoid AI slop by strictly implementing bold, high-contrast broadsheet editorial styling.
Do not center-align body text or main containers. Use left-aligned newsprint layouts.
Every interactive element must have hover states, focus states, and data-testid attributes.
Do NOT use transparent dropdown backgrounds or missing contrast overlays.
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications on comment submission, article saving, and admin actions.
